pages.title: Xel'Naga Construct
pages.text: $(l)Health$(): 250, shields 150$(br)$(l)Damage$(): 14, every 1 s, range 6$(br)$(l)Speed$(): 2.8, on the ground$(br2)$(o)StarCraft II numbers (LotV).$()
A keeper of the xel'naga temples (Zeratul's co-op avatar): wild, of no side, it fights anyone in its temple and does not leave it.
